en: A colorized historical postcard view of a wooden pier or bridge leading from the beach toward ornate seaside buildings. People in late 19th or early 20th century clothing stroll along the pier, some holding parasols. Decorative lampposts line the structure, and in the distance there is an elaborate pavilion and several grand villas or hotels surrounded by trees. The number "392" is written in red in the upper right corner. At the bottom, the captions read "Heringsdorf." on the left and "Kaiser Wilhelm-Brücke II." on the right.
